description: Current score for one match — the fastest, lowest-latency read. Use this when you only need the score and already know the match id. Works on the FREE plan (no card needed).

match_id.description: Match id, as returned by get_live_matches, get_upcoming_matches or get_recent_results.

name: get_match_score

message.description: Human-readable summary. Identical to the text content, so either half can be used alone.

ok.description: True when the call returned data. False for a tier wall, a missing or rejected key, or an empty result — all of which are normal states with a clear remedy, not failures.

win_probability_p1.description: Model probability player 1 wins, 0-1. ULTRA only.

title: Match score
